nodes.summary: The LDpred-inf posterior (Vilhjálmsson et al. 2015; the likelihood `β̂ | β ~ N(R β, R / N)` of Zhu and Stephens 2017): with `M` markers, `N` individuals, heritability `h² > 0`, effects `β ~ N(0, h² / M · I)`, an LD matrix `R` that is positive definite, and marginal estimates `β̂ = R β + ε` with `ε ~ N(0, R / N)` independent of `β`, the posterior law of `β` given `β̂` is…
nodes.title: The LDpred-inf posterior

nodes.summary: BLUP as a conditional law (Henderson 1975; Robinson 1991): in the Gaussian mixed model `y = X b + Z u + e` with fixed effects `b`, random effects `u ~ N(0, G)` and residuals `e ~ N(0, R)` independent, `G` and `R` positive definite, the conditional law of `u` given `y` is `N(G Zᵀ V⁻¹ (y - X b), G - G Zᵀ V⁻¹ Z G)` with `V = Z G Zᵀ + R` (for almost every `y`).
nodes.title: BLUP as a conditional law

nodes.summary: BLUP is the conditional expectation in the Gaussian mixed model: `𝔼[u | y] = G Zᵀ V⁻¹ (y - X b)` almost surely.
nodes.title: BLUP is the conditional expectation

nodes.summary: The raw residual-product second moment of the marginal estimates (Zhu and Stephens 2017): if `𝔼[ε_i ε_i'] = σ² [i = i']`, then `𝔼[(β̂_j - (R β)_j)(β̂_k - (R β)_k)] = σ² / N · R_jk`.
nodes.title: The raw residual-product second moment of the marginal estimates

nodes.summary: The mean of the marginal estimates (Zhu and Stephens 2017): for fixed effects `β` and noise with mean zero, `𝔼[X_jᵀ y / N] = (R β)_j` with `R = Xᵀ X / N` (`ldCorr`).
nodes.title: The mean of the marginal estimates

nodes.summary: The MME solution is the GLS estimate and the BLUP (Henderson 1975): if moreover `Xᵀ V⁻¹ X` is invertible, the mixed-model equations have the unique solution `b̂ = (Xᵀ V⁻¹ X)⁻¹ Xᵀ V⁻¹ y` (the GLS estimate) and `û = G Zᵀ V⁻¹ (y - X b̂)`.
nodes.title: The MME solution is the GLS estimate and the BLUP

nodes.summary: Henderson's mixed-model equations (Henderson 1975; Robinson 1991): for positive definite `G` and `R` and `V = Z G Zᵀ + R`, `(b, u)` solves the mixed-model equations if and only if `b` solves the generalized least-squares normal equations `Xᵀ V⁻¹ X b = Xᵀ V⁻¹ y` and `u = G Zᵀ V⁻¹ (y - X b)`.
nodes.title: Henderson's mixed-model equations

nodes.summary: Henderson's mixed-model equations for `y = X b + Z u + e`, `Cov u = G`, `Cov e = R`: `[Xᵀ R⁻¹ X, Xᵀ R⁻¹ Z; Zᵀ R⁻¹ X, Zᵀ R⁻¹ Z + G⁻¹] [b; u] = [Xᵀ R⁻¹ y; Zᵀ R⁻¹ y]`.
nodes.title: Solution of Henderson's mixed-model equations

nodes.summary: The `N`-normalized marginal association estimate `β̂_j = X_jᵀ y / N` of marker `j` for the phenotype `y = X β + ε` (fixed effects `β`, noise `ε`).
nodes.title: Marginal association estimate of a marker

nodes.summary: The phenotypic covariance `V = Z G Zᵀ + R` of the linear mixed model `y = X b + Z u + e` with `Cov u = G`, `Cov e = R`.
nodes.title: Phenotypic covariance of a linear mixed model

nodes.summary: `V = Z G Zᵀ + R` is positive definite.
nodes.title: Positive definiteness of the phenotypic covariance

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
